# weft_host (Resource)

Registers a host in the weft cluster's host registry. Mirrors the RegisterHost / GetHost / DeleteHost RPCs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `az` (String) Availability zone (failure domain). Mutable — `weft up` may relabel during a cluster reshuffle.
- `endpoint` (String) host:port of the agent's gRPC listener. Mutable (an IP/port change is allowed without forcing replace).
- `hostname` (String) DNS hostname or operator-visible name. Immutable.
- `hypervisor` (String) Hypervisor type: "apple-vz" | "qemu-kvm" | "libvirt" — typically "qemu-kvm" on Linux hosts. Immutable.
- `rack` (String) Rack (sub-AZ failure domain). Mutable. Required even in single-rack clusters; placement rules read it.

### Optional

- `architecture` (String) CPU architecture: "arm64" | "amd64" | "riscv64". Inferred by the agent on first register if left blank. Immutable.
- `labels` (Map of String) Operator-set free-form labels. Read by scheduling rule selectors.
- `network_types` (List of String) Network backends the host supports. Defaults to ["nat","bridged","isolated","mesh"].
- `volume_backends` (List of String) Volume backends the host supports. Defaults to ["file"].

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Unix nanosecond timestamp of first registration.
- `id` (String) Mirrors `uuid`; satisfies the Terraform ID convention.
- `last_seen_at` (String) Unix nanosecond timestamp of most recent heartbeat.
- `state` (String) active | draining | down — observed by the control plane.
- `uuid` (String) Server-minted host UUID. Stable across re-registrations.
